"""Pricing rules: tier discounts applied to a basket, in integer cents."""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_EVEN, ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from .basket import Basket

TIERS_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "tiers"


def load_tier(name: str) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
    """A tier table: SKU prefix -> discount rate."""
    path = TIERS_DIR / f"{name}.csv"
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(handle))
    return {row["prefix"]: Decimal(row["rate"]) for row in rows}


def rounding_for(name: str) -> str:
    # Legacy tables were exported before ADR-0001 and still round half up.
    if (TIERS_DIR / f"{name}.legacy").exists():
        return ROUND_HALF_UP
    return ROUND_HALF_EVEN


def apply_tier_discount(basket: Basket, *, tier: str) -> Basket:
    rates = load_tier(tier)
    rounding = rounding_for(tier)
    for line in basket.lines:
        rate = next((r for p, r in rates.items() if line.sku.startswith(p)), Decimal(0))
        discount = (Decimal(line.total_cents) * rate).quantize(Decimal(1), rounding)
        line.discount_cents = int(discount)
    return basket
tests/test_pricing.py:
"""Tier discounts."""

from pricing.basket import Basket, Line
from pricing.rules import apply_tier_discount


def test_no_tier_no_discount():
    basket = Basket([Line("SKU-1", quantity=1, unit_price_cents=1000)])
    assert apply_tier_discount(basket, tier="none").total_cents == 1000


def test_bulk_discount_rounding():
    basket = Basket([Line("SKU-12", quantity=40, unit_price_cents=4999)])
    assert apply_tier_discount(basket, tier="bulk").total_cents == 189962
